## Change

Describe the resource or editorial change and why it is useful.

## Access and provenance

State the official source, cost/access conditions, publication status, and date reviewed.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_catalog.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build_readme.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build_readme.py --check`
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`
- [ ] No copyrighted third-party documents or sensitive operational data added
- [ ] Existing IDs and material access/cost notes preserved
